Charming 4-Bedroom Home with Mother-in-Law Suite in a Prime Neighborhood. 

Discover the perfect blend of comfort, sustainability, and convenience in this beautifully upgraded 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, nestled in a well-established neighborhood. Boasting solar power, this energy-efficient property helps reduce utility costs while offering modern living at its best.

The spacious mother-in-law suite provides additional privacy, making it ideal for extended family, guests, or even rental potential. The mother-in-law suite is furnished with a kitchen, bathroom, and living space.  

A wood-burning fireplace creates a cozy ambiance in the living area, while the inside laundry room adds to the home's convenience. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the RV and boat parking, along with a two-car garage for ample storage and parking. Additional storage solutions throughout the home ensure plenty of space for all your needs. Inside, you'll find newly upgraded bathrooms and flooring, adding a fresh, stylish touch to the home. The enclosed back porch is the perfect retreat to enjoy late Texas springs and summers, offering a peaceful space to relax or entertain.

Don’t miss this opportunity to own a thoughtfully upgraded home in a fantastic location—schedule a tour today!

1 full bath, 1 half bath
